limits: Aligote, Chenin, Enfariné, Gringet, Marsanne, Roussanne and Sacy together: at most 5%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Jura appellation of four communes, making wine from Savagnin Blanc and Chardonnay, with Poulsard also allowed. Its types include wine from raisined grapes. Jura is a cool-climate region best known for vin jaune.
